title: Disentangle to create: Architecture-level disentangled diffusion model for few-shot Chinese font generation
abstract: arXiv:2602.18874v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Few-shot Chinese font generation aims to synthesize new characters in a target style using only a handful of reference images. Achieving accurate content rendering and faithful style transfer requires effective disentanglement between content and style. However, most existing approaches achieve only feature-level disentanglement and allow the generator to re-entangle these features, leading to content distortion and degraded style fidelity. To address this, we propose the Architecture-Level Disentangled Diffusion Model (ALD-Font) with an asymmetric design. The U-Net backbone takes SimSun-style glyphs as content templates, concatenated with noisy latents to construct a spatial canvas. Style features extracted from target-style images are injected as modulation signals to guide generation. translated_title: 解缠以创造：面向少样本中文字体生成的架构级解缠扩散模型
translated_abstract: 少样本中文字体生成旨在仅使用少量参考图像合成目标风格的新字符。实现准确的内容渲染和忠实的风格迁移需要在内容与风格之间进行有效的解缠。然而，大多数现有方法仅实现了特征级的解缠，并允许生成器重新纠缠这些特征，从而导致内容失真和风格保真度下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出了具有非对称设计的架构级解缠扩散模型。U-Net骨干网络以宋体风格的字形作为内容模板，与噪声潜变量拼接以构建空间画布；从目标风格图像中提取的风格特征则作为调制信号注入以引导生成。基于对解缠有效性的理论验证，我们采用参数高效微调（PEFT）策略，仅更新……
tldr: 提出架构级解缠扩散模型ALD-Font，通过非对称设计将内容模板与风格调制信号在架构层面彻底分离，显著提升了少样本中文字体生成中的内容准确性与风格保真度。
en_tdlr: Proposes ALD-Font, an architecture-level disentangled diffusion model with an asymmetric design that thoroughly separates content templates from style modulation signals at the architecture level, significantly improving content accuracy and style fidelity in few-shot Chinese font generation.
